_about: Keys the settings interface exposes and nothing acts on. Regenerate with `python3 scripts/settings-usage-audit.py --write-baseline` and read the diff: an entry that leaves means the key got wired or the reason stopped matching, which is the only good reason for one to go. The reason text is part of the identity, so a key that stops being unwired for the reviewed reason is a new debt and has to be re-reviewed.
